english: We next examined and depicted the reverse remodeling trajectory in young hearts using the Rev-nAAC model.

The first 4 weeks of aortic constriction induced profound cardiac function impairment and ventricular remodeling in both the nAAC and Rev-nAAC groups, with no significant difference at this baseline (Figure 2A).
Functional recovery became evident in Rev-nAAC mice at 6 weeks, and by 8 weeks, LV ejection fraction (%) and fraction shortening (%) were restored to Sham levels (Figure 2A; Figure S2A).
However, Rev-nAAC mice demonstrated only partial structural recovery and persistent diastolic dysfunction in echocardiography until 12 weeks.
LV internal diameter at diastole, LV internal diameter at systole, and LV mass remained significantly elevated in Rev-nAAC mice compared with Sham controls (Figure 2A; Figure S2B).
Additionally, E-wave to A-wave ratio (E/A) and E-wave to E’-wave ratio (E/E’) were significantly increased in 12-week-old Rev-nAAC mice (Figure S2C through S2E).
chinese: 接下来，我们使用Rev-nAAC模型研究并描绘了年轻心脏的逆向重塑轨迹。
主动脉缩窄的前4周，nAAC组和Rev-nAAC组均出现严重的心脏功能障碍和心室重塑，且基线水平无显著差异（图2A）。
Rev-nAAC小鼠在6周时开始出现功能恢复，到8周时，左心室射血分数（%）和短轴缩短率（%）恢复至假手术组水平（图2A；图S2A）。
然而，Rev-nAAC小鼠在12周前仅表现出部分结构恢复，且超声心动图显示舒张功能障碍持续存在。
与假手术对照组相比，Rev-nAAC小鼠的舒张末期内径、收缩末期内径和左心室质量均显著升高（图2A；图S2B）。
此外，12周龄Rev-nAAC小鼠的E波/A波比值（E/A）和E波/E’波比值（E/E’）显著升高（图S2C至S2E）。
